request.task: Decide whether the service is sufficiently supported as complying with the 90-day data-retention policy.
required_information: Evidence must cover actual retained age, not only configured TTL intent.
Evidence must cover primary, replica, and backup/archive storage where retained copies can exist.
Evidence must account for legal-hold exceptions separately from ordinary retention.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether the service is sufficiently supported as complying with the 90-day data-retention policy.

evidence.observation: Inventory sampling shows no ordinary primary or replica record older than 90 days.
Backup and archive inventory shows ordinary recoverable copies expire by day 90.
Records exceeding 90 days are all mapped to active legal holds and excluded from ordinary deletion.

label: sufficient
rationale: Observed age is compliant across all relevant storage classes and legal holds are separated.
